A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE COUNTY BUDGET FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2016

On this day, the 2th day of August 2016, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners having met for the purpose of discussing and passing a resolution, amending the County budget for the 2016 fiscal year do resolve that.

Whereas, the actual expenditures of Treutlen County for the current fiscal year have changed to meet the needs of the County; and,

Whereas, the Board of Commissioners in the Budget Resolution for Fiscal Year 2016 reserved the right to amend said budget; and,

Whereas, the Board of Commissioners of Treutlen County are required to provide a balanced budget and approve all budgetary changes at the departmental level,

THEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, such resolution is adopted, and the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners issues the following Budget

Amendments for the General Fund and all other funds under their control.

Alvin Wheeler, Chairman

Treutlen County Board of Commissioners

Douglas R, Eaves, County Manager
